address.description: Shown once. The secret is not stored in clear text.

project_id.description: Required unless raw_text is set. An explicit list overrides a parsed ^list or ~list.

title.description: Required unless raw_text yields a title. An explicit title overrides the parse.

raw_text.description: Quick add text. The server parses it (RF-102). Explicit fields in this body override the parse.
